name: Costly Menace
summary: Darren Malvew of Southshore hates losing the town's beautiful horses. Undead, the Syndicate gang and assorted scoundrels have cost plenty, but Darren says nothing threatens them more than the mountain lions that keep coming down from the hills of Alterac.

sections.title: Horses Lost
sections.body: Darren Malvew of Southshore cannot stand losing the beautiful horses there. Quite a few have been lost to undead creeps, the Syndicate gang and the scoundrels poking about the region. By Darren's own word, though, no menace to the horses is bigger than the mountain lions up in Alterac, forever coming down from the hills.

sections.title: Lions of the Hills
sections.body: Darren wants the lions dealt with: eight Mountain Lions and ten Hulking Mountain Lions. Mountain Lions are found in the lower hills of the Alterac Mountains.

faq.answer: Darren Malvew is of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills, and is fed up with losing the town's horses.

faq.q: Where are the mountain lions coming from?
faq.answer: They come down from the hills of Alterac. Mountain Lions are found in the lower hills of the Alterac Mountains.

faq.q: What threats to the horses does Darren mention?
faq.answer: Undead creeps, the Syndicate gang and other scoundrels in the region have cost Southshore horses, but Darren says the mountain lions of Alterac are the biggest menace of all.

faq.q: What specific beasts need to be culled?
faq.answer: Eight Mountain Lions and ten Hulking Mountain Lions.
